title: PUBLIC SAFETY COMMITTEE REPORT relative to an overview of the Los Angeles Police Department (LAPD) Virtual Reality Training Program impacts and analysis.
text:
[Council File 24-1430; CD 1]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
PUBLIC SAFETY COMMITTEE REPORT relative to an overview of the Los Angeles Police Department (LAPD) Virtual Reality Training Program impacts and analysis.
Recommendation for Council action:
NOTE and FILE the Board of Police Commissioners report dated April 11, 2025, attached to Council file 24-1430, relative to an overview of the Los Angeles Police Department Virtual Reality Training Program impacts and analysis.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the Board of Police Commissioners. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted.
summary: Council receives and files a Police Commission report on the impacts of the LAPD's virtual reality training program, with no further action.

outcome.text: Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 20, 2026); Council action final
